scope.frontend: Single guided conversation, one missing question per turn, bilingual answer buttons, suggested level first, optional profile summary, and crawlable explanatory content. No form or tabs.
scope.backend: Confirmed age, experience, observed readiness and support determine a provisional stage; current courses are filtered by mapped stage, age and difficulty. AI classifies concerns but does not author placement advice.
